questions.question: How many total cards must a legal competitive Pokemon TCG deck contain?
evidence: legal Pokemon Trading Card Game deck for competitive play must contain exactly sixty cards

questions.question: How many ACE SPEC cards can a player include in their deck?
evidence: permitted to include only one single ACE SPEC card in their entire sixty-card deck

questions.question: What happens if a player cannot draw a card at the start of their turn because the deck is empty?
evidence: failing to draw because the deck has zero remaining cards results in an immediate loss by deckout

questions.question: How is the Confused Special Condition indicated on the card?
evidence: Confused: The card is turned completely upside down (180 degrees)

questions.question: What Item card allows evolving a Basic Pokemon directly into a Stage 2 form?
evidence: Rare Candy allows a player to evolve a Basic Pokemon directly into a Stage 2

questions.question: How many Prize cards does an opponent take when Knocking Out a Pokemon ex?
evidence: when a Pokemon ex is Knocked Out, the opponent takes two Prize cards
